standard-dialogue-before-starting-eagles.npc: Yes, er, welcome to the zoo! I'm afraid I'm kind of busy right now; what was it you wanted?

options.text: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!

steps.player: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!

steps.text: If the player is below level 27 in Hunter:

steps.npc: Well... maybe. How much do you know about hunting?

steps.player: Well I know a little bit...

steps.npc: No, I could do with some help, but I'm afraid I need somebody with a little more experience.

steps.text: If the player is level 27 or above in Hunter:

steps.npc: Actually, now that you come to mention it, you might be able to help me.
A few weeks ago we had a delivery of a northern ferret. They're funny little creatures. Turns out they're tricksy little blighters too.
Whilst we were unloading him from the cart he managed to escape his cage. What's more he gave the driver a nasty nip on the way out too.
This was obviously a bit of a blow, you can't make a new attraction without any animals.
We got in contact with one of our associates, a huntsman called Nickolaus, who agreed to capture us another.
Funny thing is we haven't heard from him for some time now. I don't suppose you'd mind having a look for him?

options.text: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?

steps.player: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?

steps.npc: Well the northern ferret is mostly found around the mountains just west of the Gnome Stronghold, so that would probably be as good a place as any to start looking.

options.text: Sorry, I don't have the time.

steps.player: Sorry, I don't have the time.

steps.npc: Oh well, I'm sure he'll be okay out there on his own.

options.text: Where did you get the animals from?

steps.player: Where did you get the animals from?

steps.npc: We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.

steps.player: Where on Gielinor did you get that scary looking Cyclops?!

steps.npc: He's from a very far away land, we couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!

standard-dialogue-after-completing-eagle.player: Hi, how are you getting on with that ferret?

standard-dialogue-after-completing-eagle.npc: Well he seems to be just as vicious as the one we lost, but we're still very grateful for your help in acquiring him.

standard-dialogue-using-a-ferret-on-char.player: Hey, I've got another ferret if you're interested?

standard-dialogue-using-a-ferret-on-char.npc: Er, oh! Well that's very kind of you, but we don't really need another ferret at the moment, I'm afraid. We're having enough trouble taming the one we've got.
